subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: A 'base register presence differs (g0 vs gN)' reject from the WebFrank renaming bisimulation is NOT evidence of an SDA21-vs-absolute addressing-mode difference. It is the `li`/`addi` extended-mnemonic artifact: `li rD,K` IS `addi rD,0,K`, so its RA field is literally 0, while a register copy `addi rD,rS,0` has RA=rS. A positional bisimulation comparing the two therefore reports a base-register field of g0 against gN even though no relocation and no addressing mode is involved. The inference 'RA=0 means the linker supplies the base' is sound ONLY for an instruction actually carrying an R_PPC_EMB_SDA21 relocation; it is invalid when applied to the RA field of an arbitrary D-form instruction. DIRECT REFUTATION of the SDA21 framing in claim.webfrank-eligibility-frontier-closed.20260831.v1: all nine functions it grouped under that signature were re-diffed with `fndiff --clean` and ZERO of them show any SDA21-vs-absolute divergence. In every case the genuinely SDA21-relocated instructions appear as UNCHANGED CONTEXT lines in both streams (e.g. AudioUnloadPart's `lwz r4,0(0) @gAudioBankTbl(EMB_SDA21)`, fn_80054E78's `lfd f2,0(0) EMB_SDA21`, scroll_credits' `lwz ...,0(0) EMB_SDA21`), and every ADDR16_HA/ADDR16_LO absolute pair is likewise present and identical on both sides. The nine decompose into THREE already-known mechanisms, none of them addressing-mode and none of them a new class: (1) CONSTANT-COPY-VS-REMATERIALIZE, five members -- AudioBankLoadName (+0x34 target `addi r25,r30,0` vs ours `li r25,0`), AudioBankQueueName (+0x34 `addi r29,r28,0`), AudioUnloadPart (+0x24 `addi r29,r31,0`), fn_8006E654 (+0x3c `addi r30,r29,0`), and one cluster of gamemain fn_80054E78 (`addi r30,r29,0`); this is exactly claim.law.constant-copy-vs-rematerialize-is-source-unreachable.20260831.v1, already parked with an exhaustive do-not-retry list. (2) PREHEADER SCHEDULE, two members -- CritterLoadDone and CritterLoadStartNext, whose only divergence is that target emits the loop's `li r5,0` index init BEFORE the hoisted base-address `addi r4,r3,LO` while ours emits it after; opcode multiset IDENTICAL (0t), a pure reorder. (3) REGISTER PERMUTATION, two members -- LoadPdataFile (r24/r25/r26/r28 rotation, all ADDR16_LO forms identical on both sides) and scroll_credits (r26/r27/r28/r29/r30/r31 rotation). scroll_credits carries one genuinely non-register difference that is also NOT addressing-mode: its `lis`/`addi` pair relocates against `<local>` in target but against the named symbol `credit_text` in ours -- a relocation-symbol-granularity/data-layout question, not a choice between small-data and absolute addressing. CONSEQUENCE FOR PLANNING: there is no 'SDA21 addressing-mode class' to drive and no declaration-shape lever to find; -sdata/-sdata2 thresholds, extern sizedness, and splits.txt section placement are all irrelevant to these nine. Any future sweep must triage a base-register-field reject by reading the instruction's RELOCATION annotation before naming a mechanism.
